about: The tractus of the formulary “Most Precious Blood of Our Lord Jesus Christ” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: God hath graced us in His beloved Son, in whom we have redemption through His Blood. The remission of sins, according to the riches of His grace, which hath abounded in us. Being justified freely by His grace, through the redemption which is in Christ Jesus. Whom God hath set forth as a propitiation through faith in His Blood.
g: oblige, gratify, humor, show kindness to
